Match the completed front Image 1 materials and source-faithful palette. No extra labels, ticker names, platform marks, numbers or footer boxes.

Do not copy the front name/ticker/description panel shapes. The ENTIRE reverse, including the top band, must form one continuous finished identity composition in the matching native metal/ceramic/lacquer material. Only authentic lettering contained in the exact source logo is allowed.
